why: The operator's own store list marks this branch, and only this branch of five, as shut: 「金閣寺店 休業中 / 住所 〒603-8375 京都府京都市北区衣笠天神森町６−１ / 営業時間 現在休業中 / 定休日 月曜日 / 電話番号 0753662301」 — the address matches the record exactly. Tabelog independently agrees: the listing carries 「このお店は店舗情報の確認が取れていないため掲載保留中です。」 Checked 2026-08-21. I am deliberately NOT calling this closed_permanently: the operator's word is 休業中 (suspended), not 閉店, no closing date is given, and the most recent Tabelog review is a 2026/04 visit titled 「リニューアルオープン」, so the branch was trading four months ago. A human should decide whether the app hides it; what is certain is that the record currently shows a shop the operator says is not open, under a name (「油そば 大革命 金閣寺店」) it stopped using in August 2025.
